volatile_output_hash_policy: Earlier revisions of this ledger recorded SHA-256 digests of the bundled generated validation outputs. Those outputs are declared volatile (excluded from STABLE_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json) and are regenerated by the release-lock commands, and this ledger is itself hash-bound by structured evidence records, so any recorded digest of a volatile output goes stale the moment the outputs are regenerated after the ledger is sealed - a fixed point does not exist. This revision therefore records statuses and check counts (the deterministic, byte-independent contract) and no volatile-output digests; integrity of the volatile outputs is established by rerunning the RELEASE_LOCK.json commands, not by digest comparison against this ledger.
